items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: In fact, I didn't know Ory personally.

ctx.x: Wow. So many people moved away. That's right. And he was one that moved. Did you ever hear Kid Ory when you were a kid?
No, I can't ever recall what he and Ory played outside of his records. In fact, I didn't know Ory personally.
What about Duke Ellington? You know him personally?

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: No mention of Don Albert in relation to Kidori; Kidori is mentioned only by the Interviewer in the context of George Lewis.

ctx.x: He's a good musician. He played with George Lewis the last time I heard him up in Columbus, Bill.
He made a trip to Europe with Kidori, too, about four years ago.
